svg.title: Potential flow around a cylinder
svg.desc: Streamlines of an incompressible, irrotational flow around a cylinder, shown as a grey disk. Far from the cylinder the streamlines are straight horizontal lines. Near the cylinder they bend around it symmetrically, so that the pattern is the same in front of and behind the cylinder. The flow splits at a stagnation point on the left of the cylinder and joins again at a stagnation point on the right.

g.font-family: 'Latin Modern Math', 'STIX Two Math', 'Cambria Math', serif
